node.statement: Joint universal thresholds: choose witnesses (C_der^I,C_ch^I,C_pol^I,C_grp^I,kappa_der^I,kappa_ch^I,kappa_pol^I) from lem-stage1-inversion-derivative-control, (C_pol^P,kappa_pol^P) from lem-stage1-polar-retraction, (C_ch^G,kappa_ch^G) from lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control, and (C_grp^A,C_pol^A,kappa_pol^A) from lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws. Define C_der^0=C_der^I, C_ch^0=max(C_ch^I,C_ch^G), C_pol^0=max(C_pol^I,C_pol^P,C_pol^A), C_grp^0=max(C_grp^I,C_grp^A), kappa_der^0=kappa_der^I, kappa_ch^0=min(kappa_ch^I,kappa_ch^G), and kappa_pol^0=min(kappa_pol^I,kappa_pol^P,kappa_pol^A). These are universal, the four coefficient thresholds are at least 1, and the three margin thresholds lie in (0,1/2].
